doc.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997

title: Swing as pop music and Down Beat
summary: Swing was the pop music of his youth, with Down Beat as a must-read.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: The swing music of that era, it was the pop music of the day. Is that correct?
Exactly. My mother or father went and turned the radio on, and that’s what we heard. Wasn’t I lucky?

Yeah. And I look at some of the books back from then and some of the magazine things, and they actually had fan clubs for the bands, just like rock & roll today. And they knew who was playing with who.
Oh Down Beat magazine was a must with all of us. It had all the personnel changes, where the bands were playing, and reviewing recordings.
